accountScreen.preferenceCenterIntro1: Tracking technologies like cookies and pixels are used in our mobile applications and online services to collect information about you and your device. We may also use software development kits (SDKs) to understand how you use our app and to deliver relevant experiences.

accountScreen.preferenceDetailEssentialBody: These are necessary for the app to function and cannot be switched off. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, account login, or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you to these tracking technologies, but some parts of the app will not work as a result.
accountScreen.preferenceDetailPerformanceBody: These allow us to get to know how you use our app. They're used to track visits and traffic to help us see how effective our advertising is and understand what you like. We also use this information to help improve our app, make our marketing more relevant, and improve your experience.
accountScreen.preferenceDetailFunctionalBody: These enable the app to provide enhanced functionality and personalization. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added. If you do not allow these, then some of the app may not function properly.
accountScreen.preferenceDetailMarketingBody: These technologies may be used to deliver advertisements and offers that are more relevant to you, measure how our campaigns perform, and understand how you interact with our ads. They may be set by us or our advertising partners. If you do not allow these, you may still see general advertising, but it may be less tailored to your interests.
accountScreen.preferenceDetailSessionReplayBody: Session replay may be used to review user interactions in a privacy-conscious way to diagnose issues and improve usability. Data is handled according to our Privacy Policy.
accountScreen.preferenceDetailFallbackBody: Detailed description for this preference will appear here when content is available.
